item.name: Old Downtown/Waterfront/North End Walking Tour
item.description:
#Make Boston yours as we explore the beauty and history of Boston’s earliest beginnings that formed the architecture, personality and charm that IS Boston today!  

##Duration:

- 2 hours

##Highlights include:

- The North End, Boston’s Italian Area.
- The beautiful Harbor Area and how it was formed
- Some of Boston’s oldest architecture
- The Old North Church and Paul Revere’s House
- The “hidden” Waterfront Trail

##About
An interesting history of Boston and its architecture, from the time the city was founded in 1630 until today. Learn how Boston’s three hills were used as part of the largest land-fill operation in the world. 

See how the first settlers viewed Boston – and who was here to greet them! Some of Boston’s most interesting buildings are seen, including the Old North Church and Paul Revere’s House in Boston’s Italian North End. 

Your guide will explain about the Boston Stone in the oldest remaining commercial block in the city. You'll see America's oldest restaurant and America's oldest tavern. You'll walk over the infamous "Big Dig" which now makes up the Rose Kennedy Greenway.

So much to see! At the end of the tour, your guide will be happy to recommend some great Italian North End restaurants or direct you to the New England Aquarium or the Institute of Contemporary Art. 


**Meeting Location**

Near the intersection of State & Congress Streets (Downtown Boston, MA)
(Exact meeting location details will be provided immediately upon purchase of tickets.)
item.booking_notes:
**Important Notice:** Please arrive at least 10 minutes before your scheduled tour time, as tours depart right on time.

**Meeting Location:** The tour will meet on the NW corner of State and Congress Streets, across from the Old State House. Your Boston CityWalks Tour Guide will have either a dark shirt or jacket with the "Boston CityWalks" name and a dark blue "Boston CityWalks" cap. If you have any trouble locating the tour, please call 508.904.2819.

**What to Wear**

You will be outside for much of the tour, so dress for the forecasted weather! We recommend layers, as the temperatures can become higher throughout the day. (It's easy to peel a layer off!)
Wear comfortable walking shoes.
On sunny days, we suggest you use sunscreen. Hats and sunglasses can also be helpful.
If the weather forecast calls for rain or showers, rain jackets, umbrellas and hats can help. On most tours, the guide will have emergency ponchos available in case of unexpected inclement weather.
 
**What to Bring/What Not to Bring**

We suggest you bring a bottle of water with you. These can also be purchased at street vendors along the way. (If you intend to purchase water, be sure to bring some extra cash!)
If you have young children, it is highly recommended that you bring a folding carriage with you, as kids do get tired along the way.
And of course, BRING YOUR CAMERA!!
 
**Other Tips & Guidelines**

Please arrive at least 10 minutes before scheduled departure time.
If there are any particular types of things you would like to see or hear about, please get ready to let your guide know.
If you have any problems or questions prior to the tour, you can call our main number at 866-WE-WALKS. If you need to reach us close to tour time, call 508-904-2819.
Gratuities are not required, but certainly are welcome and appreciated!!
